def: a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e. (figuratively) scar of service

occurrences.text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
